name: claude-seo-ai
description: Audit and opt-in-fix classic SEO and AI-search visibility (GEO/AEO) for any website or web codebase — works on any platform (Shopify, WordPress, Next.js, Webflow, Wix…). Two independent scores, reproducible findings, safe deterministic fixes.

SHOPIFY_STORE.title: Shopify store domain
SHOPIFY_STORE.description: my-store.myshopify.com. Needed by the Shopify theme and Admin adapters; also exported to the CLI as SHOPIFY_FLAG_STORE.

SHOPIFY_THEME_TOKEN.title: Shopify Theme Access token
SHOPIFY_THEME_TOKEN.description: Theme Access app token for the Shopify CLI. Passed to the child process env as SHOPIFY_CLI_THEME_TOKEN, never on a command line. Pushes go to an unpublished theme; publishing is a separate confirmed step.

SHOPIFY_ADMIN_TOKEN.title: Shopify Admin API token
SHOPIFY_ADMIN_TOKEN.description: Admin API access token, sent as the X-Shopify-Access-Token header for per-resource SEO fields (product/collection/page seo, redirects).

WP_URL.title: WordPress site URL
WP_URL.description: https:// only — Basic auth over http would put the application password on the wire in clear.

WP_USER.title: WordPress user name
WP_USER.description: The user the application password belongs to.

WP_APP_PASSWORD.title: WordPress application password
WP_APP_PASSWORD.description: Users -> Profile -> Application Passwords. Spaces are preserved. Never a real account password.

WP_SSH.title: WP-CLI SSH target
WP_SSH.description: user@host:/path/to/wordpress for the WP-CLI adapter. Used only when the REST path is unavailable.

WEBFLOW_TOKEN.title: Webflow API token
WEBFLOW_TOKEN.description: Site API token (Bearer) for page SEO and Open Graph fields. Page writes are staged; publishing is a separate confirmed step.

WEBFLOW_SITE_ID.title: Webflow site id
WEBFLOW_SITE_ID.description: Also readable from the page markup as data-wf-site.

WIX_API_KEY.title: Wix API key
WIX_API_KEY.description: Sent as the Authorization header. Wix static-page SEO writes can publish immediately, so they are flagged as live impact.

GHOST_URL.title: Ghost site URL
GHOST_URL.description: https://blog.example.com — the Admin API lives under /ghost/api/admin/.

GHOST_ADMIN_KEY.title: Ghost Admin API key
GHOST_ADMIN_KEY.description: <id>:<secret> form; the secret signs a short-lived JWT locally. Never leaves the machine.

HUBSPOT_TOKEN.title: HubSpot private app token
HUBSPOT_TOKEN.description: Bearer token for CMS page SEO fields. Drafts are pushed live only on a second confirmation.

BIGCOMMERCE_STORE_HASH.title: BigCommerce store hash
BIGCOMMERCE_STORE_HASH.description: The store hash in the API base path.

BIGCOMMERCE_TOKEN.title: BigCommerce API token
BIGCOMMERCE_TOKEN.description: Sent as X-Auth-Token for product and page meta fields.

PSI_API_KEY.title: PageSpeed Insights API key
PSI_API_KEY.description: Optional. Raises the PSI quota for Core Web Vitals; the audit runs without it at a lower rate limit.
